name: Premium Golden Pothos (Money Plant)
description: An extremely popular indoor plant known for its air-purifying qualities and trailing vines of heart-shaped leaves splashed with gold.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Moderate (once a week, let soil dry)
careInstructions.sunlight: Indirect bright light, tolerates low light
careInstructions.fertilizer: Once a month in spring & summer

name: Luxury Snake Plant (Sansevieria Laurentii)
description: Architectural and highly resilient. Snake plant is famous for emitting oxygen at night, making it the perfect bedroom companion.

careInstructions.sunlight: Indirect sun, survives in dark corners

name: Mini Jade Plant (Succulent)
description: Thought to bring good fortune, this dwarf succulent features thick, shiny, fleshy leaves on wood-like stems.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Very Low (water only when leaves wrinkle)
careInstructions.fertilizer: Quarter strength fertilizer in growing season

name: Red Hibiscus Plant
description: Classic tropical shrub producing gorgeous, large, trumpet-shaped red blooms that attract butterflies and hummingbirds.

careInstructions.waterLevel: High (keep soil moist, especially in summers)
careInstructions.fertilizer: High potassium organic fertilizer every 2 weeks

name: Premium Ficus Bonsai (Ginseng)
description: Artistically pruned thick, pot-bellied trunk with glossy green foliage. Highly popular indoor beginner bonsai tree.

careInstructions.sunlight: Bright indirect sun, morning direct sun helpful
careInstructions.fertilizer: Organic Bonsai food once in 15 days

name: Organic Heirloom Tomato Seeds
description: High germination organic seeds for big, juicy heirloom tomatoes. 95% germination rate tested.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Keep moist during germination, moderate after

name: Marigold Flower Seeds (Double Petal)
description: Vibrant yellow and orange double-petalled marigold seeds. Helps repel garden pests naturally.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Mist daily till germination, then water alternate days
careInstructions.fertilizer: Balanced NPK fertilizer during bud stage

name: Premium Aerated Potting Mix (With Cocopeat & Perlite)
description: Highly aerated organic potting mix enriched with micro-nutrients, charcoal, perlite, and premium cocopeat to prevent root rot.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Excellent water retention, water when topsoil is completely dry

name: Organic Vermicompost (Nutrient Rich)
description: 100% organic earthworm manure. Enriches soil structure, improves aeration, and acts as a powerful plant growth promoter.

careInstructions.fertilizer: Is a fertilizer itself, add 2 handfuls monthly to plants

name: Handcrafted Terracotta Clay Pot
description: Classic breathable red clay pots. Porous walls allow air and moisture to reach the roots, keeping plants healthy.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Soak in water before first use. Breathable walls absorb water.
careInstructions.sunlight: UV resistant, can stand full outdoor sun

name: Sleek Glassmorphism Self-Watering Pot
description: Innovative dual-layer plastic pot with a transparent reservoir. Keeps the plant watered for up to 2 weeks automatically.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Refill outer reservoir when water indicator drops to minimum
careInstructions.fertilizer: Can mix liquid fertilizer in the reservoir

name: Polished Snow-White Decorative Stones
description: Perfect for landscaping, top-dressing pots, indoor zen gardens, or accentuating walkway pathways.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Wash with water occasionally to retain the shining white texture

name: Neem Oil Pesticide Spray (Organic)
description: Ready-to-use organic neem spray. Effective against mealybugs, aphids, spider mites, and whiteflies.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Spray once in 15 days on leaves for protection, or once a week for active infestation
careInstructions.sunlight: Spray during early morning or evening. Avoid midday hot sun.

name: Royal Velvet Red Rose Bouquet
description: Hand-crafted bouquet of 12 fresh Dutch red roses with Gypsy fillers and eco-friendly burlap wrapping.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Trim stems by 1cm and place in fresh clean vase water
careInstructions.sunlight: Keep in cool shaded room away from direct sunlight

name: Exotic Purple Orchid & Lily Bouquet
description: Luxurious arrangement of imported purple Dendrobium Orchids, Asiatic Lilies, and lush green monstera foliage.

careInstructions.waterLevel: Change vase water every 2 days and mist petals gently
